description: This Kotlin file defines a singleton object `GameLogic` that provides game operation methods for a tic-tac-toe game, such as making a move, resetting the game, and creating a new game. It operates on `GameState`, `Player`, and `Board` models and contains logic for handling game rules and state transitions without Android dependencies.

methods.name: makeMove
methods.description: Attempts to make a move for a specified player at a given row and column within the current game state. Checks for game completion, places the mark, determines the winner or draw, and updates the game state accordingly.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the current board and returns a new game state with Player X to start.

methods.name: newGame
methods.description: Creates and returns a new GameState with an empty board and Player X set to start.
